parent_asin.meaning: Recorded product ID; return it, never invent IDs.

title.meaning: Listing title; searchable text, not a verified attribute.

sleeve.meaning: full means long; half means short; unknown cannot prove a sleeve.

style.meaning: Recorded style text; office is ranked with broader listing evidence.

price_usd.meaning: Historical/estimated USD amount; may be missing.

price_source.meaning: Price provenance; do not restrict unless explicitly requested.

price_inr_est.meaning: Historical price conversion or estimate in INR, not live price.

color.meaning: Pipe-separated exact shade tokens; do not merge shades.

pattern.meaning: One category from the supplied vocabulary.

fabric.meaning: Semicolon-separated material tokens; exact material matching.

fit_review_n.meaning: Number of reviews contributing fit evidence.

fit_feedback.meaning: Recorded fit feedback; not a comfort sentiment score.

review_count.meaning: Recorded review count, distinct from rating count.

vision_status.meaning: Heuristic visual processing status, not verified accuracy.

color_main.meaning: Saved main visual shade; app independently enforces dominance.

color_status.meaning: Color processing status, not a guarantee of correct color.

sizes.meaning: Pipe-separated recorded size tokens; historical mentions, not live stock.

brand.meaning: Recorded brand, with source store fallback.
